title: Low-Vision Audit — Finding extensions
description: Audit-specific extensions to the base finding schema (shared/schemas/finding.base.schema.json). Adds fields; does not redefine the base contract. Does NOT extend the shared load_displaced_to enum — low-vision failures map onto the fixed shared enum (see the mapping table in RUBRIC.md).

lv_reflow_pattern.description: Optional. For Section 0 (Zoom & Reflow) findings, classifies the reflow failure shape: text_loss = text clipped/hidden via overflow at 200% (LV-200-LOSS); horizontal_scroll = two-directional scrolling forced at 320 px (LV-320-SCROLL); reflow_content_loss = content unreachable, not merely restyled (LV-REFLOW-LOSS); sticky_block = sticky chrome consuming disproportionate viewport height at 400% (LV-STICKY-BLOCK); overlap = columns/sections overlapping when enlarged; spacing_collapse = line spacing collapsing under magnification. Optional/omitted (or 'n/a') for findings in other sections.
